ui_bugs.issue: Carryover from iter17: Radix Select dropdowns emit a benign ResizeObserver loop warning that the CRA dev-overlay (webpack-dev-server-client-overlay) renders as a full-screen red overlay intercepting clicks in the preview environment. Production builds are unaffected. Mitigation in tests: monkey-patch window.ResizeObserver. Recommendation: add the same shim once globally (e.g., in index.js) so manual QA on the preview URL is not blocked.

action_items: MEDIUM (carryover from iter17): silence the benign ResizeObserver loop warning emitted by Radix Select on open by wrapping window.ResizeObserver globally in index.js so the CRA dev-overlay does not block preview-URL clicks. Production unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: register_maker/routes.py — data sheets are stored full-bytes in Mongo (file_b64). 25 MB max per file × N tenants × 12 months will balloon Mongo. Move to GridFS/S3 before GA (same risk as Phase A templates).
register_maker/routes.py — list_data_sources / list_generations likely run per-doc shape transforms in Python; fine at <500 docs but flag as N+1 risk if data sheets per org grow.

register_maker/data_sources.py + generator.py + routes.py — together push routes.py to 685 lines and the dashboard SPA to 986 lines. Both are over the 700-line guideline. Recommend extracting DataSheetsTab + GenerateTab + GenerationDetailDialog into separate component files (note already raised in iter17 as well).

register_maker/generator.py — fill_xlsx_template's 'tolerant establishment lookup with synonyms' silently swallows mismatches. Worth logging which static fields fell back to synonyms so support can debug a tenant's wrong-name bug without re-running AI.

Frontend GenerationRow polls /generations/{id} every 4s indefinitely once visible; cap polling after status='ready' or 'failed' to avoid unbounded background traffic if user leaves dashboard open (verify in code).

Frontend RegisterMakerDashboard.js single file at 986 lines — split DataSheetsTab/GenerateTab/GenerationDetailDialog/DataSourceRow/GenerationRow into /components/register_maker/* before Phase C lands.
